rows.note: Use 放 as the all-purpose choice for physically placing someone or something somewhere.

example.english: I put the book on the table.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 fong3 hai2 toi4 min6

rows.note: Use 加 when putting an abstract restriction, label, responsibility, or other attribute onto something.

example.english: The company put many restrictions in the contract.
example.traditional: 公司喺份合約入面加咗好多限制。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hai2 fan6 hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 haan6 zai3

rows.note: Use 搞到 when putting someone or something into a resulting state or condition, especially in casual speech.

example.english: You put me in a very awkward position.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Use 講成 when wording or presenting something as a particular description or interpretation.

example.english: Don't put it as if it were all my fault.
example.traditional: 唔好將件事講成係我錯晒。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 sing4 hai6 ngo5 co3 saai3
